hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
cd services/picsure-dictionary
# . is the same as source, but works in jenkins shell . /usr/local/docker-config/dictionary/dictionary.env rm -f db/flyway/flyway.conf echo "flyway.url=jdbc:postgresql://$POSTGRES_HOST:5432/$POSTGRES_DB" >> db/flyway/flyway.conf echo "flyway.user=$POSTGRES_USER" >> db/flyway/flyway.conf echo "flyway.password=$POSTGRES_PASSWORD" >> db/flyway/flyway.conf
mkdir -p /usr/local/docker-config/flyway/dictionary/sql/ cp -f db/flyway/flyway.conf /usr/local/docker-config/flyway/dictionary/flyway.conf cp -f db/flyway/* /usr/local/docker-config/flyway/dictionary/sql/
# Fail fast if the database is missing: flyway treats it as a connection error # and retries for ~2 hours. This happens when the postgres entrypoint's first # init was interrupted after initdb (see PIC-SURE Dictionary API Build and Deploy). for i in $(seq 1 60); do docker exec dictionary-db pg_isready -q -h 127.0.0.1 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" && break if [ "$i" -eq 60 ]; then echo "ERROR: dictionary-db did not become ready after 120s" exit 2 fi sleep 2 done if [ "$(docker exec dictionary-db psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d postgres -tAc \ "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname = '$POSTGRES_DB'")" != "1" ]; then set +x echo "ERROR: database '$POSTGRES_DB' does not exist in dictionary-db." echo "Its first-start init likely failed (check: docker logs dictionary-db). Init is skipped once" echo "the data directory exists, so reset it (it holds no data yet) and re-run" echo "'PIC-SURE Dictionary API Build and Deploy' to recreate it:" echo " docker rm -f dictionary-db && rm -rf $DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/dictionary/db/data" exit 2 fi
docker run --rm --name dictionary-flyway \ --env-file /usr/local/docker-config/dictionary/dictionary.env \ -v $DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/flyway/dictionary/sql/:/flyway/sql \ -v $DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/flyway/dictionary/flyway.conf:/flyway/conf/flyway.conf \ --network dictionary \ flyway/flyway:11-alpine -connectRetries=60 -validateMigrationNaming=true migrate
